passage: Because of a national shortage, the clinic has only a three-week supply of the standard flu vaccine. Children, pregnant patients, and adults over 65 will receive priority until a new shipment arrives. Other patients may book appointments for late October or use partner pharmacies, which currently have supply. COVID vaccines are unaffected.

keyPoints.text: A flu-vaccine shortage means the clinic will prioritize children, pregnant patients, and adults over 65.
Other patients should book for late October or use partner pharmacies.

referenceAnswer: A flu-vaccine shortage means priority groups get the clinic's remaining supply; others should book late October or use pharmacies.
